subject: general
question: Find compound interest on Rs. 60000 at 10% per annum for 5 years, compounded annually.
solution:
**Given:**

Principal = Rs.60000 ; Rate% = 10% ; Time = 5 years

**Formula used:**

A = P × (100 + R%)T

Compound interest (C.I) = (A - P)

Where, A = amount ; P = principal ; T = time ; R = rate

**Calculation:**

Amount = P × (100 + R%)T

⇒ 60000 × (110/100)⁵

⇒ 60000 × (11/10)5

⇒ 60000 × (161051/100000)

⇒ 6 × 16105.1 = 96630.6

Compound interest (C.I) = (A - P)

⇒ 96630.6 - 60000 = 36630.60

**∴ The correct answer is Rs.36630.60.**
